correctness.rationale: After centering \(Y=y-1/b\), exact differentiation gives \(\dot V=(1/b-a)x^2-bY^2-cz^2\); the standalone checker verifies the polynomial cancellation coefficient-by-coefficient. For \(a>1/b\) this gives the global exponential estimate with \(m=\min\{a-1/b,b,c\}\). At equality \(V\) is proper and nonincreasing, and the largest invariant subset of \(\{Y=0,z=0\}\) is \(Q_0\) because \(\dot z=-x\). The bounded-complete formula follows by integrating \(\dot y+by=1-x^2\) backwards and taking \(T\to\infty\). The invariant-measure conclusion follows by integrating the nonpositive generator identity over compact invariant measures.

value.rationale: The result isolates a mathematically natural open-loop no-recurrence region in a repeatedly used chaotic-finance benchmark, gives an explicit global exponential rate away from the boundary, closes the semidefinite endpoint, and provides a pointwise ceiling for every bounded complete non-equilibrium trajectory. It strictly extends the exact Aybar Darboux identity from one special parameter curve to a full closed half-space \(a\ge1/b\) rather than selecting an arbitrary numerical slice.
